claim: EV-0052 records the CP22 self-amdgpu-runtime codec/admission boundary. It validates fixed 4096-byte payload-v2 request and response records, capability bit 8 dependencies, owner-scoped stage identities, CRC and zero-tail rules, canonical failures, geometry/signal bounds, and the explicit unsupported Triton preload boundary. It does not implement a daemon handler, mapping lease, kernarg publication, AQL submission, launcher, simulator execution, or fallback.
command_argv:
set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('projects/self-amdgpu-runtime')
status=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'],text=True)
paths=[line[3:] for line in status.splitlines() if line]
expected=['include/self_amdgpu_runtime/runtime.h','src/transport.c','src/transport_codec.c','src/transport_internal.h','tests/CMakeLists.txt','tests/generic_dispatch_v2_transport_test.c']
assert sorted(paths)==sorted(expected),paths
assert subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(root),'diff','--check'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True).returncode==0
diff=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'diff','--binary','--full-index','--',*expected])
h=hashlib.sha256(diff).hexdigest()
files={p:{'bytes':(root/p).stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in expected}
print(json.dumps({'base_head':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'base_tree':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip(),'status_paths':paths,'diff_check':'pass','working_diff_sha256':h,'files':files,'scope':'codec/schema/admission-only; no daemon, gem5, launcher, execution, or root edits'},sort_keys=True))
PY

set -eu
python3 -m json.tool protocol/host-transport-v2.json >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
schema=Path('protocol/host-transport-v2.json'); docs=Path('docs/host-transport-v2.md')
value=json.loads(schema.read_text())
assert value['checkpoint']=='CP-0022' and value['versioning']['framing_major']==1 and value['versioning']['payload_major']==2
assert value['capability']['bit']==8 and value['transport']['record_bytes']==4096
assert value['transport']['message_types']=={'GENERIC_DISPATCH_REQUEST':18,'GENERIC_DISPATCH_ACK':19,'GENERIC_DISPATCH_COMPLETION':20}
assert value['acceptance_boundary']['execution'] is False and value['bounded_fixture_observation']['descriptor_preload_dwords']==12
print(json.dumps({'schema_sha256':hashlib.sha256(schema.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'schema_bytes':schema.stat().st_size,'docs_sha256':hashlib.sha256(docs.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'docs_bytes':docs.stat().st_size,'json':'valid','codec_boundary':'pass','execution':False},sort_keys=True))
PY

limitations: The child is intentionally captured before its CP22 commit; EV-0053 must bind the eventual commit and clean tree.
The capability bit is codec/API validation only. The current daemon and gem5 bridge do not advertise or route message types 18/19/20.
The v1 A1 contract remains fixture-only with zero public mapping, descriptor, code, and kernarg VAs.
The retained Triton descriptor preload is 12 DWORD (48 bytes) and is explicitly NOT_SUPPORTED until native preload and +256-byte entry semantics are implemented.
No normal launcher, compiler/JIT invocation, GPU mapping, kernarg byte publication, AQL queue submission, simulator execution, output differential, or CPU/NVIDIA fallback result is claimed.
